revision: R2 after obligation-author clarification of temporary StyleChain resolution and contract publication

read: P1429 public adversarial artifacts as protocol precedent
role_boundary.inherited_context: shared parent conversation and shared workspace; isolation is not attestable

policy.opaque_controls: U01-U06 must classify Unknown with acceptance=false and mutation_credit=false

physical_campaign.construction_time: after a candidate implementation exists, without changing this mutation intent
physical_campaign.isolation: one fresh local clone or worktree per mutant; no mutation stacking
requirements: one unique focused killer command per mutant
record patch SHA-256, candidate tree, command, exit code, bounded stdout/stderr and attributable witness
run the unmutated focused suite first and require PASS
a compile failure is Violated only when the patch deliberately mutates a public type/signature invariant and the failure is attributable; incidental build failure is Unknown
timeout, OOM, swap, truncation, opaque identity or non-attributable failure is Unknown and blocks the score

mutants.mutation: Omit math.cases, register a non-function, or alias it to mat/vec/generic content.
mutants.required_killer: qualified lookup plus callable invocation and func/repr identity
mutants.witness: math.cases is missing, non-callable, or returns a carrier whose public identity is not cases

mutants.mutation: Require at least one child, cap children, collapse one child, reorder many children, or accept children only as a tuple.
mutants.required_killer: zero, one and at least three positional children with order-sensitive repr/plain-text witnesses
mutants.witness: (), singleton tuple morphology, cardinality or child order differs

mutants.mutation: Accept an integer positional child, silently drop it, or report a non-attributable error.
mutants.required_killer: integer positional probe requiring the frozen expected-content diagnostic
mutants.witness: invalid positional input constructs content or diagnostic identity differs

mutants.mutation: Accept children: named, unknown named, duplicate named, or an extra unsupported option.
mutants.required_killer: children:, unknown and duplicate probes, including named-before-positional ordering
mutants.witness: closed signature fails to reject with the frozen attributable diagnostic

mutants.mutation: Accept integer, arbitrary content, malformed array length, or a non-delimiter scalar for delim.
mutants.required_killer: invalid type and invalid cardinality probes plus valid none/string/symbol/array controls
mutants.witness: invalid delimiter is accepted or a valid domain member is rejected

mutants.mutation: Do not infer a matching pair from a unit delimiter, swap pair sides, convert none to a sentinel glyph, or collapse an asymmetric pair.
mutants.required_killer: unit '[', none, ('[', none), (none, ']') and explicit default-pair repr/carrier probes
mutants.witness: normalized optional pair or public none morphology differs

mutants.mutation: Coerce truthy values, accept integer reverse, or ignore an invalid explicit value.
mutants.required_killer: reverse:true/false controls and reverse:1 diagnostic
mutants.witness: non-boolean is accepted or boolean polarity is lost

mutants.mutation: Accept a unitless integer, reduce Rel<Length> to absolute Length, discard percent, or canonicalize 150% as 0pt.
mutants.required_killer: gap:1 error plus 1em, 150% and mixed relative-length carrier/repr/layout probes
mutants.witness: invalid gap is accepted or percent/length components are not preserved

mutants.mutation: Infer presence from non-default values, share one presence bit, or omit explicit defaults from repr/equality/hash.
mutants.required_killer: independent absent/present-default pairs for delim, reverse and gap, including all eight bit combinations
mutants.witness: a single causal bit no longer changes repr and structural carrier identity independently

mutants.mutation: Let cascaded delim/reverse/gap override an explicit argument, ignore cascade, or use a non-frozen default.
mutants.required_killer: default, cascade-only and explicit-over-cascade probes for each field independently
mutants.witness: effective value differs from explicit > cascade > ('{','}'), false, 0.2em

mutants.mutation: Set an explicit-presence bit when a value comes only from #set math.cases.
mutants.required_killer: cascade-only effective-layout change paired with repr that still omits delim/reverse/gap
mutants.witness: repr exposes a field not causally supplied by the constructor call

mutants.mutation: Keep bare cases on the old rows carrier, ignore a named value, or use a different constructor than math.cases.
mutants.required_killer: equivalent bare/qualified calls across zero/many children and all three named fields
mutants.witness: carrier, repr, plain-text or visible geometry differs between routes

mutants.mutation: Split MathAlignPoint during eval, evaluate a child twice, or evaluate children out of source order.
mutants.required_killer: carrier inspection preserving '&' plus stateful/order-sensitive child evaluation witness
mutants.witness: align point disappears before layout or per-child evaluation count/order differs from exactly once in source order

mutants.mutation: Omit or default a child, delimiter side, reverse, gap or presence bit in clone/equality/hash/map_content/map_text/apply_math_default/apply_math_style.
mutants.required_killer: single-cause pair matrix and reconstruction round trips; map_content descends only into children while map_text remains terminal
mutants.witness: distinct carriers collapse, a field changes after reconstruction, or walker scope changes

mutants.mutation: Print positional children, omit children:, lose singleton comma/order, emit sentinel delimiters, reorder optional fields, or expose cascaded fields.
mutants.required_killer: exact repr for zero/one/many children and each independent explicit field
mutants.witness: repr differs from cases(delim?, reverse?, gap?, children: tuple)

mutants.mutation: Treat '&' as an extra row/visible glyph/global grid column, or fail to align boundaries within each branch.
mutants.required_killer: two or more branches with distinct left/right widths around '&' and a no-align control
mutants.witness: branch baselines/order, natural symbol spacing or aligned boundary coordinates differ

mutants.mutation: Always draw the left side, draw both sides, invert reverse polarity, or render a None side.
mutants.required_killer: asymmetric ('[', ']'), left-none/right-present and left-present/right-none under reverse false/true
mutants.witness: visible delimiter count, side, glyph or x-position differs

mutants.mutation: Ignore gap, use a fixed 0.2em, resolve percent against font size/zero instead of the required exterior style basis, or apply gap per cell rather than per branch.
mutants.required_killer: two-branch geometry at default, 1em, 150% and mixed relative value under two exterior sizes
mutants.witness: exact inter-branch baseline delta fails the frozen relative-resolution relation

mutants.mutation: Use unconditional script scaling, double axis-offset the delimiter, reintroduce delimiter padding, align component tops, or drop delimiter ascent/descent from outer bounds.
mutants.required_killer: focused geometric controls for P919/P923/P945/P1042/P1132 with short/tall grids and stretchy delimiter
mutants.witness: denominator style, delimiter x advance, grid axis, delimiter local y, or outer ascent/descent differs

mutants.mutation: Expose the row-based compatibility wrapper publicly, flatten established cells, lose inserted boundaries, or change pre-P1430 geometry at an old call site.
mutants.required_killer: legacy multi-row/multi-cell call-site control plus public-surface inventory
mutants.witness: existing row/cell boundaries or geometry change, or a second public row-based constructor becomes reachable

mutants.mutation: Treat ambiguous identity/cardinality/cascade/layout, build failure, timeout, OOM, swap or truncated observation as Preserved or grant mutation credit.
mutants.required_killer: executable U01-U06 harness with exact public reason codes
mutants.witness: any opaque control has acceptance=true, mutation_credit=true or contributes to mutation_score

opaque_controls.condition: callable or returned carrier identity cannot be observed
child count/order observation is unavailable or truncated
source of effective value cannot distinguish explicit from cascaded
geometry observer cannot identify delimiter side, branch bounds or align boundary
build/test timeout, OOM, swap, signal or non-attributable failure
required stdout/stderr witness exceeds or loses the bounded capture

expected_discriminatory_result.note: This R1 artifact defines mutation intent before candidate code. It is not a physical execution receipt and cannot by itself seal the contract.
